While we watch, the notion of Due Process/presumption of innocence and Habeus Corpus are being fed into the wood chipper. Now athletes need to prove they were not doping in the past by providing evidence that they were tested and clean years and years ago. Well, these are athletes so why should anyone care?

You should all know that I don't normally comment on sports because I don't give a shit about sports. And I am not a Russian.

But I see something nefarious here. We should care about this process being done in the name of Global Humanity because a international precedent is being set.

What I see going on with this doping scandal strikes me as emblematic of the Internationalist-Globalist mindset that we see reflective in how the EU Commission runs itself and dictates laws from Brussels. It is emblematic of how the European super state is evolving: Arrogant, unelected officials are making undemocratic decisions beyond what they should have the authority to make and they are doing it with a seeming rejection of basic LIBERAL principles.

Here is from the story:

IAAF president Sebastian Coe said the decision was made "in the best interests of the sport."

"We have to make sure that for generations to come, that athletes are competing, the public have confidence in what they're watching, and that we have athletes in safe and secure systems," Britain's two-time Olympic gold medalist told CNN's Amanda Davies in Vienna.

Best interest of the sport? Like the sport is real and that you have some credibility to represent "the Sport" when you have not even been elected by those involved? What arrogance!

And then to tell an individual athlete that they cannot compete because they have the wrong nationality? Pure chutzpah!!

This is in direct contravention of the spirit of the Olympic games but it is directly in the spirit of building a Global sense that it is OK for unelected bodies to dish out collective punishment. Think about that. The Olympics may be irrelevant (and I think that they are) but the precedent has meaning and bodes ill for our democratic futures and our individual right to be judged on our own merits.

More, the principle of Due Process/innocent until proven guilty has been turned on its head. Why is the USA/OBama letting this failure of principles become the accepted example??

"I am in shock," javelin thrower Very Rebrik told Tass. "I will keep getting ready for the Olympics until the very end, no matter what happens, as I am not involved in all of these scandals."

"This is an unfair decision," triple jumper Yekaterina Koneva told Tass. "The big question is why they are doing this to Russia." Pole vaulter Yelena Isinbayeva, who won Olympic gold in 2004 and 2008, went even further, saying: "This is a violation of human rights. I will not be silent. I will take measures."

The unfairness of the International Olympic Committee/IWAF in rejecting the rights of individuals seems to have gone by unnoticed. Why? Where is the Media to point out this unfairness, this illiberal action? Oh, that is right. Russia is to be hated and what ever one does to Russia must be "A-Ok!".

But this is not about Russia, not about sports really. This is about choosing to make a precedent where individual human rights go undefended.

The Media and the Global elites want to eclipse our concern for individual human rights, our concern for the rights of mere athletes with our disdain for cheaters and maybe even Russians.

This is just one step is socializing the world into the undemocratic and illiberal process yet to come our way.
